title: Cobblemon: Furret Supremacy
description: This Project Is A Cobblemon Datapack That Increases Furret Spawns, Spawn Levels, And Replaces All Sentrets For Furrets.
body: This Datapack Is For Furret Enjoyers That Believe That Theres Not Enough Furrets In The Game And Want More Furrets. Features Enclude 5-10x Furret Spawns, Replacing Sentret Spawns Completely And Allowing Furrets To Spawn At A Higher Level
